final:
-- Reference model: the list with its first and last elements exchanged.
-- An empty or one-element list comes back unchanged.
ends_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex ends_swapped([]) == []
  ex ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  var r: List[int] = []
  let n = xs.len()
  if n < 2
    for x in xs
      r.append(x)
    return r
  r.append(xs[n - 1])
  for i in range(1, n - 1)
    r.append(xs[i])
  r.append(xs[0])
  r

-- In place: the first and last elements of xs trade places, so afterwards
-- xs holds ends_swapped of its earlier contents. Nothing is returned.
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  xs = ends_swapped(xs)

test_ends_swapped() =
  assert ends_swapped([]) == []
  assert ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  assert ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]

test_swap_ends() =
  var a: List[int] = [1, 2, 3, 4]
  swap_ends(&a)
  assert a == [4, 2, 3, 1]
  var b: List[int] = [9]
  swap_ends(&b)
  assert b == [9]
  var c: List[int] = []
  swap_ends(&c)
  assert c == []
